package audit

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"

	"github.com/plutoframework/pluto-core/pagination"
)

// List returns one page of the verified tenant's audit events. Filters were
// parsed and the cursor was bound to the verified scope by generated code.
func List(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	p ListPorts,
	in models.ListRequest,
) (pagination.Page[models.Entry], error) {
	return p.Events.Query(ctx, e, in)
}
